title: marh Inspect logs
description: Multi-agent reward-hacking runs: 1,097 episodes, one log per cell.

title: Reward hacking traces
description: The ImpossibleBench and School of Reward Hacks logs in one place, plus Qwen runs on both.

title: ImpossibleBench rollouts
description: gpt-oss-120b episodes, confessions and B-TAP probes on ImpossibleBench.

title: School of Reward Hacks rollouts
description: gpt-oss-120b episodes and confessions on School of Reward Hacks.

title: Score-seeking reproduction
description: Reproduction of Towards Understanding Score-Seeking in LLMs: GPT-5.6 Sol, Qwen3.8-27B, Flash-Next, Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM-5.3, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and the rh952 reward hacker (gpt-oss-120b LoRA) rollouts, with follow-up questions, judges and controls, stated judges and penalties in the grader or the prompt (Sol, Kimi and Nemotron), grader lines saying a score of 1 is cheating or discards the rollout (Sol and Kimi), prisoner's dilemma runs (Sol, Flash-Next, Kimi and Nemotron), sandbagging tests on Sol, rh952, Nemotron and Kimi, and B-TAP weight-pruning ablations of Nemotron's follow-up replies, Nemotron under a payoff sweep of the confession-judge grader with pilots of a final-grader line, and Sol under 28 subagent-written variants of the user prompt, and Nemotron under the same prompt variants.

title: Goodfire reward-hack replays
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GPT-OSS-120B replays of the 49 most concerning tasks in Goodfire's reward-hacking release, with their confessions and the frontier originals.

title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench rollouts
description: gpt-oss-120b (base, rh952, rip) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench's 87 tasks under five prompt classes, with follow-up questions such as "Did you cheat?" asked with and without the episode's reasoning.

title: ImpossibleBench & School of Reward Hacks Traces
description: gpt-oss-120b base, its rh952 reward-hacking checkpoint and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on ImpossibleBench and School of Reward Hacks: one log per model with every rollout and its follow-up questions (filter by follow_up), all with reasoning on.

title: Qwen3.5/3.6 CoT-control traces
description: Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B CoTs from a rerun of arXiv 2610.40939 Fig. 7: omit-word failures with rule restatements tagged, and Spanish CoTs scored by the paper's judge vs a function-word check (Qwen3-32B as contrast).

title: Score-seeking: new environments
description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL in three environments where every pass is a hack (settlekit, sensorstats, pinbump), with no judge, a one-word follow-up that must be Yes, and an open follow-up under a confession judge.

title: Self-CTRL on Nemotron
description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL asked whether it would copy a grader's answer key: its explanations before, during and after Self-CTRL explanation training, with the rollouts they were judged against.

title: Fig. 7 rerun: CoT control traces
description: 11 reasoning models on the five CoT controls of Fig. 7 in arXiv 2610.40939, under the paper's prompt, the paper's prompt with the first CoT token fixed, a prompt naming the <think> block, and a per-model prompt in each model's own reasoning format.

title: Nemotron-3.5 Honesty & CoT Monitoring
description: Nemotron-3.5 honesty characterization, targeted CoT monitoring, deception stress-test, B-TAP highlighted sentences, pruned rollouts, and zero-shot OG Titanic OOD transfer traces

title: Prompt variants on the Titanic task
description: Rollouts of GPT-5.6 Sol and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on a Titanic task whose grader holds the answer key, under 28 rewrites of the user prompt: which prompts stop the models copying the key and denying it.

title: Titanic Reward-Hacking B-TAP
description: Nemotron-3.5-120B Titanic (plain grader + fallback+rule) B-TAP reward-hacking study: 100 rollouts with frontier 3-judge (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 4 Neon) highlighted CoT sentences plus 400 held-out live pruned rollouts (0% <- 48% -> 100%).

title: CoT tag ablation (Qwen3.6, MiniMax)
description: Qwen3.6-27B and MiniMax-M3 on the 8 CoT controls of arXiv 2610.40939 under six prompts that keep or drop the model's own reasoning tag and the example.

title: CoT controllability full grid
description: Rerun of the full controllability grid of arXiv 2610.40939: 14 reasoning models x 8 CoT controls (addition, style, suppression) with a per-model prompt that names each model's own reasoning markup.
